name: Webform Product
description: Turns any webform submission into a Drupal Commerce order via a configurable webform handler, mapping priced webform elements to order items and driving the buyer into Commerce checkout.
project_description: Webform Product can create a Commerce order from any Webform submission. It is intended for sites that already run Drupal Commerce for fixed catalogue products but need a flexible, ad-hoc "product" for temporary or highly customisable purchases — a quick donation form, a promotional product, an event or membership fee. A single 'Webform product' submission handler is attached to a webform; prices are attached to webform elements (per-option prices, a per-element 'top' price, an "Other" amount, or a single mapped total field) as webform third-party settings. On the first save of a submission the handler builds Commerce order items from those priced elements, drops them into the current user's cart, locks the order, stores a back-reference between the submission and the order, and redirects the buyer to a configured Commerce checkout step. The module is designed around off-site (redirect) payment gateways: it rewrites the gateway return/cancel/exception URLs to its own controller routes, which finalise (place) the order and mark the submission completed on return. The 3.1.x line stores the submission→order reference in order data (no extra field required, unlike 3.0.x).
